summary: NanoMuse is an open‑source framework that lets you run AI agents locally on Android, iOS, and desktop, offering plug‑in support for custom skills. It is built in Swift and distributed via source code rather than a package manager, requiring a manual clone and build. The project targets developers who need on‑device, privacy‑preserving agents and benefits from its recent creation and active commits. Its main strength is the ability to run entirely offline, while its limited documentation, lack of a package manager, and failing test suite are notable drawbacks.

github.description: nanoMuse: an open-source personal agent for every device you own — one agent with a name and a face that does things, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and asks before anything you cannot undo. On Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows / macOS / Linux and in the browser; your phone's screen and your computer as its hands.
